about.heading: We Are Reliable Electrical Panel Builders in Surat
about.paragraph1: Nilkanth Electromech is a premier manufacturing and service company in Surat, Gujarat. We specialize in designing, manufacturing, testing, and commissioning a full spectrum of electrical panels for industrial, commercial, and infrastructure applications.
about.paragraph2: With over 14 years of industry experience, our dedicated team of engineers and technicians deliver customized power distribution solutions that maximize efficiency, safety, and operational continuity.

products.title: MCC Panel
products.description: Motor Control Centre panels for industrial motor management, automatic protection, and remote control systems.

products.title: PCC Panel
products.description: Power Control Centre panels for main power distribution, circuit monitoring, and heavy industrial load control.

products.title: APFC Panel
products.description: Automatic Power Factor Correction panels for reducing reactive power losses and minimizing electricity utility penalties.

products.title: PLC Panel
products.description: Programmable Logic Controller automation panels designed for advanced industrial machinery and process control.

products.title: DG Sync Panel
products.description: Diesel Generator synchronisation panels for automated load sharing, parallel operation, and zero-break power transfer.

products.title: Outdoor LT Panel
products.description: Weather-resistant outdoor Low Tension panels with IP55/65 enclosures for demanding exterior industrial environments.

services.title: Fabrication Work (Control Panel)

services.title: H.V/L.V. Cable Laying

services.title: L.T./H.T. Panel Commissioning
